summary: New sense 1: (mit l-) geloben, weihen; (mit naḏro) ein Gelübde ablegen

data.gloss: (mit l-) geloben, weihen; (mit naḏro) ein Gelübde ablegen

rationale: Two independent sources support sacred commitment with a cognate vow or a person dedicated to a monastery. The headword existed as a stub; stem I is supported provisionally by the unaugmented forms.

summary: New stem I (nḏəlla (3sg.f Preterit); Nuḏrólewa (Preterit-wa); Infectum nicht belegt)

data.forms: nḏəlla (3sg.f Preterit); Nuḏrólewa (Preterit-wa); Infectum nicht belegt

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (MAC Besim History of Bsorino/51)

data.turoyo: Ŭ kul ʕáylaste obowa u+naʕimayḏa, u+bəkkər, l Mor+Gabriyèl, tamo d̥qore, dyolaf ŭ d̥owe dayroyo. Nuḏrólewa ltamo.
data.translation: And every family would give their child, their firstborn, to Mor Gabriel so that he could study there (lit. there so that he study), learn there and become a monk. It dedicated him to there.

rationale: First Preterit-wa evidence for dedicating a child; exact inflection remains an editorial question.

data.turoyo: Kul barṯo nḏəlla naḏro li ldaṯalo, kul ḥḏo dinoro.
data.translation: Jede ihrer Töchter gelobte der Mutter Gottes ein Gelübde, jede ein Goldstück.

rationale: First Preterit evidence; cognate object, sacred dedicatee and promised amount.

summary: Correct the readers’ absence claim: nḏr is already an etymologized entry stub with notes PrS 14/1 and to vow. The revision supplies a stem, sense and source examples rather than creating a duplicate root.

The theme can be a cognate naḏro with an amount and l-dedicatee, or a child resumed from the preceding clause with l-monastery/ltamo goal. Both express ritual commitment; no separate person-dedication sense is needed on present evidence.
The cognate noun naḏro does not itself prove a light verb with a semantically empty verb; keep it in the lexical sense rather than duplicate it in Idiomatic phrases.
The two observed forms are supplied as attested forms because the canonical Preterit/Infectum pair is not securely recoverable. No unobserved Infectum or masculine citation form has been invented.
Keep nḏr distinct from roof-rolling ndr and seeing nḏ̣r. The added I assignment is provisional pending a native paradigm; the two secure sacred-commitment contexts justify the lexical entry.
Confirm stem I and the canonical Preterit/Infectum pair, including r+l assimilation in nḏəlla and the object, agent and -wa segmentation of Nuḏrólewa.
Does Nuḏrólewa resume the feminine household as agent or an impersonal donor? The preceding obowa is feminine; the later suffix sequence is not securely segmented.
What does the inherited PrS 14/1 stub reference point to? The assigned new vow passage is PrS 6/10; do not replace the unexamined inherited note.
